summary: Man fell ~10-15 ft while scrambling at the base of the First Flatiron in Chautauqua Park, injuring his lower leg and complaining of a head injury; walked out on his own power with rescuers.
location: Base of First Flatiron, Chautauqua Park (City of Boulder Open Space)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group + Boulder Fire + Boulder OSMP + AMR + Boulder County Sheriff
notes: BCSO case 17-1518 (911 call 1:34 p.m.). Victim identified in release as Bikrum Sehgal. Dedupe: distinct from id 334's unspecified fatal First Flatiron falls.
